title: contractSelection
responsibility: Resolves contract identities and project-relative path boundaries, combines metadata filters and produces compact summaries.

inputs.name: contractPath.root
inputs.description: Project root used to resolve the query lexically; source files do not need to exist.

inputs.name: contractPath.query
inputs.description: Absolute or root-relative path to normalize; targets outside the project root are rejected.

inputs.name: selectContracts.entries
inputs.description: Eligible stored contract records; an exact unit id takes precedence over interpreting the target as a path.

inputs.name: selectContracts.target
inputs.description: Unit id, contract-file path, owned source-file path or folder; folder matching uses slash boundaries.

inputs.name: selectContracts.root
inputs.description: Project root used when the target is a path rather than an exact stored identity.

inputs.name: filterContracts.entries
inputs.description: Catalog records to retain by active status, optional kind, source area and owned-path folder.

inputs.name: filterContracts.options
inputs.description: ContractOptions whose filters combine; includeRetired admits tombstones and folder paths resolve from root or the current directory.

inputs.name: contractSummary.entry
inputs.description: Complete query record to project to identity, kind, title, source path, contract path and responsibility only.

outputs.name: contractPath
outputs.description: Normalized root-relative slash path, with the project root represented by an empty string and no trailing slash.

outputs.name: selectContracts
outputs.description: Matching records in input order, using identity precedence and exact/subtree owned-path matching without opening source.

outputs.name: filterContracts
outputs.description: Records satisfying the combined status, kind, area and folder filters, preserving input order.

outputs.name: contractSummary
outputs.description: A new summary with id, kind, title, path, contractPath and responsibility; manifest and state detail are omitted.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The requested folder resolves outside the configured project root.
